parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. This token is generated by the client and must be unique for each request. The token can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length.

parameters.name: EnableStatus
parameters.description: The status of the record. Valid values: enable and **disable**.

parameters.name: RecordId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the recursion record.
